pm.name: Mark Carney
pm.title: Prime Minister of Canada
pm.bio: Prime Minister since March 14, 2025 and MP for Nepean since the April 2025 general election. Before entering politics he served as Governor of the Bank of Canada (2008–2013) and Governor of the Bank of England (2013–2020), and as UN Special Envoy on Climate Action and Finance.

ratings.metric: Approve of the Prime Minister's job performance
ratings.detail: Up 11 points since August and approaching Carney's record high of 63% recorded earlier in 2026 after his Davos speech

ratings.metric: Approve of Carney's handling of Canada-U.S. relations
ratings.detail: Up 9 points from the previous measurement; approval is highest among Liberal (96%), NDP (67%) and Bloc (62%) voters and lowest among Conservatives (40%) — this measures the Canada-U.S. file, not overall job performance
36% dissatisfied; satisfaction with the government and approval of Carney's performance have each risen three points since August, and the Liberals sit at 49% among decided voters

opposition.name: Pierre Poilievre
opposition.title: Leader of the Official Opposition
opposition.bio: Leader of the Conservative Party since September 2022 and Leader of the Official Opposition. First elected to the House of Commons in 2004, he returned to Parliament as MP for Battle River—Crowfoot through an August 2025 by-election after two decades representing Carleton.

ratings.detail: 60% view him unfavourably — a new low in ARI tracking, with roughly three-in-five holding a negative view throughout 2026
46% negative — net −11, down from 37%/43% (net −6) two weeks earlier
Four-week rolling average; down from 23.7% in early July, with Carney at 49.9%
